Subject: AP routing & payment path for pilot

Hi Sarah —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap and the small set of items we discussed so we have a clear mutual action plan: 

- Pilot scope: 3 seats, 1 model endpoint, expected monthly usage ~20k tokens (est. first-month spend ~$3,200).
- Procurement constraints you flagged: corporate card for purchases < $5k, POs required for IT vendors when annualized spend > $25k, vendor registration portal required.
- VeraMed preference: Marketplace procurement is preferred where possible to speed onboarding; otherwise AP requires vendor setup + W-9 + DPA.

Questions we need answers to confirm the commercial path:
1) Will the initial pilot be processed as a one-off card payment or will Procurement require a PO right away?
2) If a PO is required, who is the PO approver and what is the typical lead time (business days)?
3) Any specific AP fields we should include on invoices (cost center, GL code, PO number format)?

What we can do from Redwood to make this smooth:
- We can accept credit card for the pilot if spend stays under your $5k card threshold.
- If Procurement wants a PO, we can issue monthly invoices net30 against the PO and add any required invoice fields (cost center / PO number).
- We can onboard via the VeraMed marketplace if you share the marketplace vendor invite/link — that usually reduces vendor setup time by 2–3 weeks.

I attached a short vendor onboarding form and our standard SOW template to speed Procurement review.

Proposed next steps:
- Sarah: confirm preferred payment route for pilot (card vs PO via marketplace) and share procurement contact / PO approver + expected timeline.
- Jasmine: if PO required, I’ll send an invoice template and list of required Redwood legal/compliance docs (W-9, DPA).
- Marissa: please stand by to advise on any commercial exceptions if VeraMed needs pilot on card but > $5k.

Thanks — happy to hop on a 15-min call with Procurement if that helps move the PO path faster.

Best,
Jasmine Liu
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Thanks Jasmine — good recap. A few clarifications from our side: 

- For pilots we typically allow card if total expected spend < $5k and Procurement has the budget code pre-authorized. If the pilot is likely to roll into a multi-month engagement > $25k annualized, Procurement will insist on a PO.
- Vendor registration: please complete our portal entry here: https://vendor.veramed.com/register/abc123 — our AP team requires vendor address, W-9 (US vendors), primary contact, and a copy of your DPA (data processing agreement) or equivalent.
- Invoice fields: include PO number (if provided), VeraMed cost center (we will provide after PO is raised), and remit to address: VeraMed Accounts Payable, 210 Harbor Blvd, Suite 400, San Mateo, CA 94401.
- Terms: Net30 standard; expedited terms possible for marketplace purchases.

I can route this via marketplace if Redwood is already listed there; that is the fastest route. If not, the vendor portal + AP review is the alternative (3–4 weeks typical).

Sarah Patel
Senior Procurement Manager, VeraMed
sarah.patel@veramed.com | +1 (650) 555-4421
VeraMed
